participants.note: supports targeted cleanup of surprising -no behavior; approved with suggestions on tests, -nodbcache, and Qt signer handling
ACK f65919e11592; suggested alertnotify test check, release note expansion, and identified no-wallet -nosigner bug

claims.text: rename NEGATE_TO_DEFAULT to NEGATE_TO_EMPTY and have GetArg() return empty string instead of nullopt
claims.quote: I'd suggest renaming NEGATE_TO_DEFAULT to NEGATE_TO_EMPTY and having GetArg() return "" instead of std::nullopt.
claims.status_note: author renamed to NEGATE_TO_EMPTY returning empty string

claims.text: make -noblocksdir an error instead of falling back to default blocksdir
claims.quote: Treating an empty -blocksdir= as unset looks good, but I think -noblocksdir should be an error instead of falling back to the default directory.

claims.text: treat -nobantime the same as -bantime=0 rather than disallowing negation
claims.quote: The exception is -bantime. "No ban time" can only mean a ban time of 0, or not banning, so I think -nobantime should just be treated the same as -bantime=0, whether 0 ends up allowed or rejected
claims.status_note: author removed -bantime handling from the PR
claims.status_by_quote: Done, I removed `-bantime` from the commit.

claims.text: make -nowalletdir an error instead of falling back to the default wallet directory
claims.quote: I don't think -nowalletdir should fall back to the default wallet directory, for the same reason as -noblocksdir

claims.text: make -notorcontrol an error while -listenonion is enabled or also handle -torcontrol=0
claims.quote: I think it would be safer to make -notorcontrol an error while -listenonion is enabled, asking the user to pass -nolistenonion if that's what they want, instead of soft-setting -listenonion=0.

claims.text: add a release note for newly rejected startup options
claims.quote: Not blocking, but it might be worth adding a short release note, since some settings that used to be accepted now fail at startup
claims.status_note: author added release note in a new commit
claims.status_by_quote: Added a release note in a new commit.

claims.quote: I think an error explaining how these are connected could be more helpful here

claims.text: add tests for options modified by NEGATE_TO_EMPTY
claims.quote: This only checks that the node starts with -noi2psam -norpcpassword, so most options changed in this commit have no test showing that -nofoo now does something sensible.
claims.status_note: author included provided test suite changes into the commit
claims.status_by_quote: Thanks, I added them to the `NEGATE_TO_EMPTY` commit with you as co-author and dropped the startup check.

claims.text: in builds without wallet, -signer is only registered in DummyWalletInit as a hidden option and lacks NEGATE_TO_EMPTY, causing -nosigner to still run command 0
claims.quote: In builds without the wallet, -signer is only registered by DummyWalletInit as a plain hidden option, so it doesn't get NEGATE_TO_EMPTY, but the node still reads it, for example in the enumeratesigner
claims.status_note: author moved registration to SetupServerArgs and dropped it from DummyWalletInit
claims.status_by_quote: Right, I agree with your analysis. I moved the registration to `SetupServerArgs()` into a new commit before the `NEGATE_TO_EMPTY` one and drop `-signer` from `DummyWalletInit`.

claims.text: check alert file in feature_notifications.py test since -alertnotify warning is raised again on restart
claims.quote: the test could check the alert file the same way as the other two options
claims.status_note: author adopted the alert file check

claims.text: expand release note to mention options that now work or have changed meaning
claims.quote: It could also mention the settings that now work or mean something different, since those can change what a node does after upgrading too
claims.status_by_quote: Added these to the release notes, thanks.

claims.text: display an empty signer path in the Options dialog when nosigner=1 instead of 0
claims.quote: With `nosigner=1`, the Options dialog should show an empty signer path instead of `0`.

claims.text: assert on invalid chain message in debug log to ensure alert warning recurs after restart
claims.quote: The alert-file check can pass without exercising `-noalertnotify` if the warning does not recur after restart.

claims.text: test cli -norpcuser with rpc_users.py echo instead of failing cookie authentication
claims.quote: The authentication failure is the same for an empty username and `0`, so this check does not prove `-norpcuser` works.
This test also needs to cover `-notorcontrol -listen=0`, which disables onion listening implicitly.

claims.text: append blocksdir configuration to ensure empty -blocksdir= test overrides it
claims.quote: Without a configured `blocksdir`, this test passes even if the empty `-blocksdir=` override is ignored.

claims.text: disallow negating -dbcache alongside buffer negations instead of silently selecting the 4 MiB minimum
claims.quote: `-nodbcache` silently selects the 4 MiB minimum rather than disabling the cache. It should be rejected alongside the buffer negations.

support.reason: the surprising nature of the negations was documented a few times
